verdict.rationale: Quo's homepage claims a team can share one number and stay aligned, and it documents call routing. That covers the shared-number core of the story, but only through a single marketing line. Nothing in the pack documents presence indicators, conversation assignment, or internal threads/notes. Missing for 10: presence/availability status, conversation assignment to teammates, internal comment threads, in-depth first-party docs on shared inboxes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Route incoming calls to the right person instantly
